name: Kill Ralph
source:
A small country in the eastern part of fantastical medieval Europe is teeming with bounty hunters — the most cunning scoundrels among those chasing easy money. And you are one of them.

You're no master of the sword, nor are you a seasoned warrior. Lies, deception, and betrayal are your only weapons. Yet despite that, you've set your sights on the most dangerous target of all—the legendary criminal, Ralph Devour. Will you be able to take him down on your own, or will you seek help from questionable allies? The choice is yours.

I won't wish you luck, because I don't believe in it one bit.
